chunks: Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) from Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) from Zura'ah from Sama'ah who said:
I asked him about the sale of two animals for one, so he said, 'If you specify the price, there is no objection.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell two animals for one in Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the condition for the validity of *bay' al-wahid bi al-ithnayn* (selling one animal for two), ruling it permissible (*la ba'sa bihi*) only when the specific price is explicitly named. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the removal of *gharar* (uncertainty) through precise specification of the counter-value in commodity exchanges.
